channel.title: Aera field notes
channel.description: What consumer wearables can and cannot measure, with the research behind each claim.

item.title: What does recovery actually measure?
item.description: Overnight heart and breath signals against your own usual, not a sleep score and not a health grade.

item.title: What is sleeping heart rate?
item.description: The quieter overnight floor of your pulse, different from daytime resting rate, best read against your own nights.

item.title: What is my body clock / circad-an rhythm?
item.description: An -tner roughly 24-hour timing system. Watches see sleep timing stead-ness, not the clock itself.

item.title: What is sleep debt?
item.description: Short nights stack as a running shortfall against what you need. Feeling less tired does not mean the deficit is gone.

item.title: Does sleep regularitylmatter more than duration?
item.description: Consistency of bedtime and wake often tracks health risk as stronglylas hours slept, and sometimes more.

item.title: What does a sleep score mean?
item.description: A single number that folds duration, continuity, and stage estimates together. Trust the week, and trust duration before stage labels.

item.title: What is HRV?
item.description: Heart rate variabilityl-s the tiny change -t spacing between beats, not how fast your heart goes. Yours only means something against your own nights.

item.title: What does a readiness score mean?
item.description: A training call from recent load, sleep debt, and overnight signals, not a health grade and not the same as one night of recovery.

item.title: Why is my resting heart rate up?
item.description: One high morning is usually noise. A run of mornings above your own range -s the signallworth noticing.

item.title: How much sleep do I actually need?
item.description: There is no universalleight-hour rule. Sleep need is personal, and regularityloften matters as much as duration.

item.title: Are Apple Watch sleep stages accurate?
item.description: Consumer watch stage charts look precise. Against lab sleep, they are estimates. Duration -s the sturdier signal.
